-- returns all possible moves with priority moves first
function getAllPossibleMovesInLongAlgebraic(state, color, filterForChecks)
  local moves = {}
  local priorityMoves = {}
  local idx = 1
  local priorityIdx = 1

  for x = 1,8,1
  do
    for y = 1,8,1
    do
      local piece = state.piecesGrid[x][y]
      if piece ~= nil and getPieceColor(piece) == color then
        local targetMoves = generateTargetMoves(state, color, {
            x = x,
            y = y
          })
        if filterForChecks then
          targetMoves = filterTargetMovesForChecks(state, color, {
              x = x,
              y = y
            }, targetMoves)
        end
        targetMoves = convertTargetMovesToList(targetMoves)

        for n = 1, #targetMoves
        do
          local targetMove = targetMoves[n]

          if targetMove.isCapture or targetMove.isCastleKingside or targetMove.isCastleQueenside or targetMove.isPromotion then
            priorityMoves[priorityIdx] = targetMove.longAlgebraic
            priorityIdx = priorityIdx + 1
          else
            moves[idx] = targetMove.longAlgebraic
            idx = idx + 1
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end

  moves = shuffle(moves)

  for n = 1, #moves
  do
    priorityMoves[priorityIdx] = moves[n]
    priorityIdx = priorityIdx + 1
  end

  return priorityMoves
end

-- add points for how many squares our pieces attack
function getScopeForColor(state, color)
  local scope = 0
  for x = 1,8,1
  do
    for y = 1,8,1
    do
      local piece = state.piecesGrid[x][y]
      if piece ~= nil and getPieceColor(piece) == color then
        local targetMoves = generateTargetMoves(state, color, {
            x = x,
            y = y
          })
        targetMoves = convertTargetMovesToList(targetMoves)
        local lowerPiece = string.lower(piece)

        for n = 1, #targetMoves
        do
          local targetMove = targetMoves[n]
          scope = scope + 1

          -- discourage random queen moves
          if lowerPiece == "q" then
            scope = scope - 1
          end

          -- give extra points for attacking other side of board
          if color == "w" and targetMove.y <= 3 then
            scope = scope + 1
          end

          if color == "b" and targetMove.y >= 6 then
            scope = scope + 1
          end

          -- give extra points for potential captures
          if targetMove.isCapture then
            scope = scope + 1
          end

          -- give extra points for attacking central squares
          if targetMove.x >= 4 and targetMove.x <= 5 and targetMove.y >=4 and targetMove.y <= 5 then
            scope = scope + 1
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
  return scope
end

  if globalMovesToTestIndex > #globalMovesToTest then

    local score = scoreMove(state, move, depth, depth)

function getNextMove(state, depth, startingDepth)
  local isTopLevel = false
  if depth == startingDepth then
    isTopLevel = true
  end

  local possibleMoves = getAllPossibleMovesInLongAlgebraic(state, state.activeColor, isTopLevel)

  -- score moves
  local movesToTest = #possibleMoves
  if not isTopLevel and movesToTest > maxMovesToTest then
    movesToTest = maxMovesToTest
  end

  if isTopLevel then
    globalMovesToTest = possibleMoves
    globalMovesToTestIndex = 1
    globalBestMove = nil
    globalBestScore = 0
  else
    local bestMove = nil
    local bestScore = 0

    for i = 1, movesToTest do
      local move = possibleMoves[i]
      local score = scoreMove(state, move, depth, startingDepth)

      if bestMove == nil or score > bestScore then
        bestMove = move
        bestScore = score
      end
    end

    return bestMove
  end
end

        if move.isCastleQueenside and targetMoves[x][y] ~= nil then
          local stateCopy = copyState(state)
          stateCopy.piecesGrid[4][y] = stateCopy.piecesGrid[5][y]
          stateCopy.piecesGrid[5][y] = nil

          if isInCheck(stateCopy, activeColor) then
            targetMoves[x][y] = nil
          end
        end

        if targetMoves[x][y] ~= nil then
          local stateCopy = copyState(state)
          makeMoveFromLongAlgebraic(stateCopy, targetMoves[x][y].longAlgebraic)
          if isInCheck(stateCopy, activeColor) then
            targetMoves[x][y] = nil
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end

  return targetMoves
end

function generateTargetMoves(state, activeColor, square)

    do

    end

  end

  local x = square.x
  local y = square.y

  state.targetMoves = targetMoves
  local oldActiveColor = state.activeColor
  state.activeColor = activeColor

  local lowerPiece = string.lower(piece)
  if lowerPiece == "r" then
    addTargetMovesInDirection(state, square, 0, 1)
    addTargetMovesInDirection(state, square, 0, -1)
    addTargetMovesInDirection(state, square, 1, 0)
    addTargetMovesInDirection(state, square, -1, 0)
  elseif lowerPiece == "n" then
    addTargetMove(state, square, 1, 2)
    addTargetMove(state, square, -1, 2)
    addTargetMove(state, square, 1, -2)
    addTargetMove(state, square, -1, -2)
    addTargetMove(state, square, 2, 1)
    addTargetMove(state, square, -2, 1)
    addTargetMove(state, square, 2, -1)
    addTargetMove(state, square, -2, -1)
  elseif lowerPiece == "b" then
    addTargetMovesInDirection(state, square, 1, 1)
    addTargetMovesInDirection(state, square, 1, -1)
    addTargetMovesInDirection(state, square, -1, 1)
    addTargetMovesInDirection(state, square, -1, -1)
  elseif lowerPiece == "q" then
    addTargetMovesInDirection(state, square, 0, 1)
    addTargetMovesInDirection(state, square, 0, -1)
    addTargetMovesInDirection(state, square, 1, 0)
    addTargetMovesInDirection(state, square, -1, 0)
    addTargetMovesInDirection(state, square, 1, 1)
    addTargetMovesInDirection(state, square, 1, -1)
    addTargetMovesInDirection(state, square, -1, 1)
    addTargetMovesInDirection(state, square, -1, -1)
  elseif lowerPiece == "k" then
    addTargetMove(state, square, 0, 1)
    addTargetMove(state, square, 0, -1)
    addTargetMove(state, square, 1, 0)
    addTargetMove(state, square, -1, 0)
    addTargetMove(state, square, 1, 1)
    addTargetMove(state, square, 1, -1)
    addTargetMove(state, square, -1, 1)
    addTargetMove(state, square, -1, -1)

    if piece == "k" then -- black king
      addBlackCastleTargetMove(state)
    else
      addWhiteCastleTargetMove(state)
    end
  elseif piece == "p" then -- black pawn
    if addTargetMoveNoCapture(state, square, 0, 1) and square.y == 2 then
      addTargetMoveNoCapture(state, square, 0, 2)
    end
    addTargetMovePawnCapture(state, square, 1, 1)
    addTargetMovePawnCapture(state, square, -1, 1)
  elseif piece == "P" then -- white pawn
    if addTargetMoveNoCapture(state, square, 0, -1) and square.y == 7 then
      addTargetMoveNoCapture(state, square, 0, -2)
    end
    addTargetMovePawnCapture(state, square, 1, -1)
    addTargetMovePawnCapture(state, square, -1, -1)
  end

  state.activeColor = oldActiveColor
  state.targetMoves = nil

  local originalSquareAlgebraic = squareToAlgebraic({
      x = x,
      y = y
    })

  for x = 1,8,1
  do
    for y = 1,8,1
    do
      if targetMoves[x][y] ~= nil then
        local longAlgebraic = originalSquareAlgebraic .. squareToAlgebraic({
            x = x,
            y = y
          })

        if targetMoves[x][y].isPromotion then
          longAlgebraic = longAlgebraic .. "q"
                end

        targetMoves[x][y].longAlgebraic = longAlgebraic
      end
    end
  end

  return targetMoves
end

        elseif targetMove and targetMove.isCapture then

    end
  end

        local algebraic = ""

        if lowerPiece ~= "p" then

                end

          end

function split(source, sep)
  local result, i = {}, 1
  while true do
    local a, b = source:find(sep)
    if not a then break end
    local candidate = source:sub(1, a - 1)
    if candidate ~= "" then 
      result[i] = candidate
    end i=i+1
    source = source:sub(b + 1)
  end
  if source ~= "" then 
    result[i] = source
  end
  return result
end

  local result = {

    whiteQueenside = false,
    blackKingside = false,
    blackQueenside = false

  if castlingRights == nil or castlingRights == "-" then
    return result
  end

  if string.find(castlingRights, "Q") then
    result.whiteQueenside = true
  end
  if string.find(castlingRights, "K") then
    result.whiteKingside = true
  end
  if string.find(castlingRights, "q") then
    result.blackQueenside = true
  end
  if string.find(castlingRights, "k") then
    result.blackKingside = true
  end

  return result
end

function makeMoveFromLongAlgebraic(state, algebraic)
  if algebraic == nil then
    return
  end

  local startSquare = algebraicToSquare(algebraic:sub(1, 2))
  local endSquare = algebraicToSquare(algebraic:sub(3, 4))
  local piece = state.piecesGrid[startSquare.x][startSquare.y]
  local pieceLower = string.lower(piece)
  state.piecesGrid[endSquare.x][endSquare.y] = piece
  state.piecesGrid[startSquare.x][startSquare.y] = nil

  -- promotion
  if string.find(algebraic, "q") then
    if state.activeColor == "w" then
      state.piecesGrid[endSquare.x][endSquare.y] = "Q"
        else
      state.piecesGrid[endSquare.x][endSquare.y] = "q"
        end
  end

  -- kingside castle
  if pieceLower == "k" and startSquare.x == 5 and endSquare.x == 7 then
    -- already moved king. move rook
    state.piecesGrid[6][endSquare.y] = state.piecesGrid[8][endSquare.y]
    state.piecesGrid[8][endSquare.y] = nil
  end

  -- queenside castle
  if pieceLower == "k" and startSquare.x == 5 and endSquare.x == 3 then
    -- already moved king. move rook
    state.piecesGrid[4][endSquare.y] = state.piecesGrid[1][endSquare.y]
    state.piecesGrid[1][endSquare.y] = nil
  end

  -- en passant
  state.enPassantTarget = nil
  if pieceLower == "p" then
    if startSquare.y == 2 and endSquare.y == 4 then
      state.enPassantTarget = {
        x = startSquare.x,
        y = 3
      }
    end

    if startSquare.y == 7 and endSquare.y == 5 then
      state.enPassantTarget = {
        x = startSquare.x,
        y = 6
      }
    end
  end

  if startSquare.x == 5 and startSquare.y == 1 then
    state.castlingRights.blackKingside = false
    state.castlingRights.blackQueenside = false
  end
  if startSquare.x == 1 and startSquare.y == 1 then
    state.castlingRights.blackQueenside = false
  end
  if startSquare.x == 8 and startSquare.y == 1 then
    state.castlingRights.blackKingside = false
  end

  if startSquare.x == 5 and startSquare.y == 8 then
    state.castlingRights.whiteKingside = false
    state.castlingRights.whiteQueenside = false
  end
  if startSquare.x == 1 and startSquare.y == 8 then
    state.castlingRights.whiteQueenside = false
  end
  if startSquare.x == 8 and startSquare.y == 8 then
    state.castlingRights.whiteKingside = false
  end
end

function getNextMoveForOpening(state)
  local nextMoves = {}
  local nextMovesIdx = 1

  for i = 1, #openings do
    for j = 1, #openings[i] do
      local openingString = openings[i][j]
      if stringStarts(openingString, state.moves) then
        local restOfOpening = string.sub(openingString, #state.moves + 2, #openingString)
        if #restOfOpening > 4 then
          local parts = split(restOfOpening, " ")
          if #parts > 0 and parts[1] then
            nextMoves[nextMovesIdx] = parts[1]
            nextMovesIdx = nextMovesIdx + 1 
          end
        end
      end     
    end
  end

  if nextMovesIdx > 1 then
    return nextMoves[math.random(#nextMoves)]
  end

  return nil
end
